==Trivia==
*<sup>[1]</sup> If a player types "yay fishing" in the chat - during an active game, not in the lobby - 2 Diamonds will fall from the sky (be sure to do it while having any Fishing Rod in hand and be in the fishing minigame). This only works once. (not available for people without chat)
*There are 4 codes available right now, while one is in-game.
*Upon using the code forestwakesup26 , You will receive 15  💎 gems  and 3 random 🔥 flames that can be used up in supply create for changing events or receiving campfire bonus.
*Every code is 1 time use.
*Currently, you can get a total of {{Diamond|47}} and 6 Random Flames from these.
*After merchandise was introduced, there is now a codes section for merch, allowing you to redeem merch codes after purchasing one through their website, which can be found [https://99-nights.com|here.]
*Using diamonds , You can buy classes from class shop
